objects.taxonomy_description: Asian proboscidean measuring 250-300 cm at shoulder weighing 3000-5000 kg. Body massive with thick wrinkled gray-brown skin and sparse body hair. Head broad with twin-domed skull. Ears relatively small compared to African elephant. Trunk (proboscis) elongated and muscular with single finger-like projection at tip. Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species. Body barrel-shaped with arched back. Legs pillar-like with five toenails on forefeet. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

objects.taxonomy_description: Edible fungus with a characteristic cap-and-stem morphology. The cap (pileus) is convex to flat, typically 3-10 cm in diameter, with a smooth or slightly scaly surface in white, brown, or tan coloration. The underside reveals gills (lamellae) radiating from the stem, ranging from white to dark brown. The cylindrical stem (stipe) is smooth, firm, and white, typically 3-8 cm in length. The overall form is umbrella-like with a fleshy, moist texture.

Flower_or_Top: Cap (pileus) is distinctly fleshy and thick, convex becoming broadly convex to flat only when highly mature.
Smooth or slightly scaly surface in white, brown, or tan coloration.
Underside reveals gills (lamellae) radiating from stem.
Stem_and_Leaves: Cylindrical stem (stipe) is smooth, firm, and white, notably stout relative to the cap width.
Gills range from white to dark brown underneath cap.
Overall umbrella-like form with fleshy, moist texture.
Root_and_Base: Stem base attaches to growing substrate.
Single central stem supporting cap structure.
Fleshy, moist texture throughout fruiting body.

objects.taxonomy_description: A suitcase is a rigid or semi-rigid rectangular container with a handle, designed for carrying personal belongings during travel.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a distinct rectangular or box-like geometric structure with defined edges and corners.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Carrying_Mechanism: A prominent handle is attached to the top or side, or retractable wheels are visible at the base for transport.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Closure_System: The object features a clear seam, zipper, or latch mechanism indicating two hinged halves that open to reveal an interior.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The exterior surface is smooth, hard-shell, or textured fabric, lacking the organic irregularities of natural materials like wood or leather hides.
